collection.title: Toyota Hi-Ace 1996 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Toyota Hi-Ace 1995 to 2009 requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Hi-Ace which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
